notes: Orders, returns and refunds as cards: a progress bar from Ordered to Delivered (or Requested to Refunded), the arrival date, the tracking number, and buttons to open the store's own orders page or the carrier. Tell Ervo about an order, paste a tracking number or send a photo of the order email

60 stores and services Ervo can open for orders and returns: Amazon, Walmart, Target, Costco, eBay, Etsy, Temu, Shein, Best Buy, Nike, Zara, DoorDash, Uber Eats, Instacart, Domino's, CVS and more, plus UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL tracking
A Files tab for Orders, where every card lives with its progress
"What do I have today?" shows the day as a card with a 3D icon per event and the time; Open calendar brings up a month with dots on busy days
Glass everywhere: frosted cards, sheets and bubbles with a hairline highlight, tuned for light and dark
The status pill only ever says simple things like Researching, Planning or Writing a draft, never your own words
Signed up on ervo.company? The QR code opens Ervo with your email filled in and sends your code right away; if your browser already has the sign-in, you go straight to your chat
Pick which Ervo is your home-screen icon, Personal or Business, with a switch in Ervo's Look. The icon changes quietly once you leave the app, no more getting kicked out
Ervo's Look scrolls without closing; a quick "Switching to Business" curtain when you change Ervos
Work settings show only for Business; the owner can create co-owner IDs; IDs are longer and never reused
Smoother: fewer heavy effects while you move around the app
